source_snapshot.items: EC.10_Link Interoperability: PCIe Gen Speed Changes
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; run NVQual Test #29; collect results/photos and inspect post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All items should be passed without system hang or reboot.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 600 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies NVIDIA tooling and generic per-iteration link/device evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; held Pending for the Test #29 generation matrix, path, widths, transitions, evidence, abort and recovery.

old_problem: A final PCIe link snapshot cannot prove every directed generation transition was requested, trained and settled at the required width without transient downtraining, identity loss or error. The path, supported generation matrix, iterations and recovery were unbound.
disposition_reason: The row clearly defines generation-speed interoperability through NVQual Test #29. Supported directed generation pairs, exact path, width, iteration count, settle deadline and recovery are safe runtime Project Configuration under ED-03/07/08/15; they do not require a new review decision. Coverage remains every signed directed pair for the full 600-minute allocation, and unsupported forcing is prohibited.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2132, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2133 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00010-V002 / 7cdc49aa10d97fd0 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the pinned Test #29 revision and complete root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/per-lane capability map before deriving the owner-approved directed start-to-target matrix.

Treat A-to-B and B-to-A as separate coverage. Establish the approved start state, record the target request and training trajectory, and require settled generation/width plus full stable device identities and function health.
Preserve/hash logs, topology and inventories; the source instruction to clear logs cannot erase baseline or first-fault evidence.
Retain the source 600-minute coverage and signed iteration/timing rules; a short smoke test or final high-speed snapshot is not equivalent.
Stop on unsupported request, failed/late transition, downtraining, missing/misbound device, driver/GPU failure, hang/reboot, new disqualifying AER or evidence gap; never retry automatically.
No NVQual/speed change, link/device query, log clearing, reset, reboot, power cycle, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Capability-backed HGX NVQual Test #29 PCIe generation-speed interoperability
test_case.purpose: Exercise every owner-approved directed PCIe generation transition on the mapped HGX path and prove full-width settled links and complete NVIDIA function health without hang, unplanned reboot or disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #29 package/configuration with compatible firmware/driver
Signed root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/per-lane generation and width capability map
Approved directed start-to-target matrix, start-state method, training/settle/deadline and transient rules
Signed iterations/timing, device/function/error acceptance and final-state contract
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, durable transition ledger, BMC/console and out-of-band recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash baseline logs, topology, negotiated state and inventories. Run only the pinned Test #29 directed matrix; for each pair record proven start generation/width, target request, training/equalization trajectory, settled generation/width, stable endpoint/GPU identities, driver function, timing and error deltas before the next transition. Stop on first anomaly; do not force unsupported speed, reset, power-cycle or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every signed directed generation pair starts from the approved state, reaches the requested generation at required width by deadline, preserves every expected NVIDIA identity/function, completes all Test #29 items for the formal duration, and produces no hang, unplanned reboot/reset or disqualifying new errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until the Test #29 matrix, capability/path map, iterations and oracle are approved. PASS requires every complete accepted directed transition. FAIL on unsupported/wrong request, failed/late/downtrained settle, missing or misbound device, function loss, hang/reboot or disqualifying error. Missing inputs/artifacts are BLOCKED; later success or reverse direction cannot erase a failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until the exact supported directed matrix, path/width, transition oracle, iterations and recovery are signed.
Prove end-to-end capability and correct target identity before each state change.
Use an isolated idle SUT with console and explicit 600-minute speed-transition authorization.
Stop without reset/power escalation or automatic retry on the first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #29 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus end-to-end generation/width/per-lane capability topology
First-fault recovery or clean final link/device/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At an unsupported request, wrong-path effect, failed/late/downtrained settle, identity/function loss, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or evidence gap, inhibit later transitions and preserve the first event. Do not force another generation, reset or power-cycle automatically; follow signed recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Items and Test #29 consistently define generation-speed interoperability; missing matrix and path values are project inputs.

blocked.reason: Review semantics are complete; runtime remains gated on proprietary Test #29 configuration, capability-backed matrix, evidence and recovery.

external_authorities.application: Allows parameterized targets while requiring transition-specific evidence, preserved duration/logs, recovery and no unsupported forcing or retry.
